content:
Lina (Marketing): Quick: CedarView case study needed for May product newsletter + May 26 webinar. Transcript done, need short pull quote, logo release, and lead routing consent. Can we land this by Thursday?
Omar (AE): I'll request logo + signed publish note from CedarView today. Also ask if they want webinar leads forwarded.
Hannah (CS): Candidate quote (unedited):
"Redwood cut our inference spend dramatically and made response times more consistent during peak hours."
Nate (Design): Short quote ok for social card. Need SVG logo and a headshot of their speaker.
Priya (Legal): Numeric claims flagged. This is non-numeric so lower risk but still get written permission. Also include embargo if they request.
automation-bot: Checklist item created: marketing/case-studies/cedarview -> assets, legal, webinar-routing.
Omar (AE): CedarView replied: logo ok, signed approval attached, speaker Kate confirmed, but they asked to remove "dramatically" and use "significantly." They also want only EMEA leads sent to their AE team.
Lina (Marketing): Update quote to: "Redwood helped us significantly lower inference costs and make responses more consistent for users." Works?
Priya (Legal): That wording is fine. Save their signed approval and note the EMEA-only routing.
Nate (Design): I'll build hero + social variants by Wed. Lina, paste final quote + attached signed email here when you have it so I can use exact wording.
Lina (Marketing): Uploading signed note now. Final quote: "Redwood helped us significantly lower inference costs and make responses more consistent for users."
Omar (AE): For routing: Sales Ops will tag webinar registrants with region and send only those tagged EMEA to CedarView webhook. I'll coordinate.
Lina (Marketing): Perf — timeline: Omar confirm routing by Tue, Nate assets Wed, publish draft + webinar blurb Thu. Thanks all :rocket:
